stemBlocks: A heater is connected in series with a resistor and a $6.0 \ \text{V}$ battery in the circuit shown. The total resistance of the circuit is $15 \ \Omega$. In $3.0$ minutes, $180 \ \text{J}$ of electrical energy is transferred into other forms in the heater.
How much charge flows through the heater in the $3.0$ minutes and what is the voltage across the heater?
